text_to_image_prompt: Create one standalone photorealistic female character portrait, 1086 x 1448 pixels, vertical 3:4. Strict frontal eye-level ID-photo composition with the entire head and upper torso visible, centered head and direct gaze, level shoulders, no head tilt or rotation. Balanced left and right cheek widths, cheekbone heights and jaw taper; level eyes and aligned nose, philtrum, lips and chin. Relaxed neutral expression. Solid pure white background, bright soft balanced frontal studio illumination, natural skin pores and fine hair detail, restrained makeup, gentle contrast and coherent warm neutral photographic grading. No scene, text, watermark, border, collage, extra person or visible hands. Dark brown hair in a messy high bun with long loose face-framing strands, warm medium skin, dark brown eyes, defined brows and muted pink lips. White thin-strap gathered dress.
original_prompt: Precise composition edit only. Keep this exact same woman's face, eyes, skin tone, expression, frontal level-eye view, clothing, hair and white lighting unchanged. Zoom the entire portrait out slightly so the COMPLETE high messy bun and ALL flyaway hair are fully inside the frame, with a clear 100-pixel white margin ABOVE the highest hair. Extend the plain white background as needed and show a little more of the upper chest. Keep single-person centered ID photo composition, shoulders straight, direct gaze. Output must remain exactly 1086 x 1448 pixels, vertical 3:4. No cropping at the crown, no new accessories, no text, no watermark.
